description: The University of B.C. and Simon Fraser University, B.C.'s two biggest universities by student enrolment, say a cyber breach of the Canvas learning software could affect students' personal information.
title: UBC, SFU among thousands of universities affected by Canvas software cyber breach

description: The U.S. military said it intercepted Iranian attacks on three navy ships in the Strait of Hormuz Thursday and "targeted Iranian military facilities responsible for attacking U.S. forces." The U.S. military said no ships were hit. Iranian state media said the country's armed forces exchanged fire with "the enemy" on Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz. It is the largest Iranian island in the Persian Gulf, home to about 150,000 people. It also houses a water desalination plant.
title: U.S. says it intercepted Iranian attacks on 3 navy ships in Strait of Hormuz

description: A man who sprayed vinegar at Democratic U.S. Rep. Ilhan Omar at a town hall meeting in Minneapolis earlier this year pleaded guilty to assault Thursday in federal court after reaching a deal with prosecutors.
title: Man who sprayed U.S. Rep. Ilhan Omar from syringe during town hall pleads guilty to assault

description: The province says larger, more modular classrooms will be built in Tumbler Ridge in the coming weeks to use while plans for a permanent high school replacement are underway.
title: Tumbler Ridge Secondary School to be torn down and rebuilt after mass shooting, province says

description: B.C. Premier David Eby says Tumbler Ridge Secondary School will be demolished and rebuilt after February's deadly mass shooting.
title: Tumbler Ridge Secondary School will be demolished and rebuilt after mass shooting, province says

description: Kodak Black was arrested this week on a drug trafficking charge in central Florida in his latest run-in with law enforcement. The rapper, whose real name is Bill Kapri, entered a not guilty plea.
title: Rapper Kodak Black arrested in Florida on felony MDMA trafficking charge and pleads not guilty

description: ‌The ​U.S. Trade ​Court on Thursday ruled ​against U.S. President Donald ‌Trump's latest 10 per cent global tariffs, finding ‌across-the-board tariffs were ​not justified under a 1970s trade ​law.
title: U.S. trade court rules against Trump's 10% global tariffs

description: In an internal note obtained by CBC News, Bell said it investigated and terminated an undisclosed number of employees for “misrepresenting their presence in the workplace." But several fired employees, and the lawyer representing them, say they believe the employees were actually fired for economic reasons, rather than misconduct.
title: Bell fires employees it claims falsified attendance records, but some deny it

description: The United States on Thursday imposed ‌financial sanctions on a sprawling business conglomerate run by Cuba's military and a Cuban-Ca
title: Toronto-based Sherritt pulls back from mining joint venture in Cuba amid expansion of U.S. sanctions

description: Maple Leaf Foods Inc. says it's reviving five Yves products, including veggie deli sliced products and original and Mexican veggie ground round.
title: Yves Veggie Cuisine making comeback with relaunch of 5 products

description: The head of Elections Canada says the Liberals' proposed electoral reform law doesn't adequately address concerns about bad actors attempting to sow doubt about the country's electoral system.
title: Reforms should target misinformation that undermines voters' trust, says elections chief

description: Rents in Canada have fallen back to the same level they were at three years ago, according to the new report from Rentals.ca and Urbanation. But average rents are still 21.9 per cent higher than the pandemic-era low of April 2021.
title: Average rent across Canada fell by 5% in April, according to report

description: When staff at the Humane Society of North Texas first saw the scared little kitten, shaking and covered in industrial-strength glue, they didn't know if he would survive the night. But after roughly 24 hours of care, the little creature was free.
title: Elmer the kitten is now thriving after he was found in a bucket of glue

description: Air travel continues to be impacted by soaring fuel prices. On Thursday, Air Canada confirmed that, due to the current high cost of jet fuel, it’s halting service earlier than planned on four seasonal flights to U.S. destinations.
title: Air Canada cuts more flights due to soaring jet fuel prices

description: The federal privacy watchdog says there have been more than 42,000 breaches at the Canada Revenue Agency since 2020 as a result of people gaining unauthorized access to, or modifying, taxpayer information.
title: Privacy watchdog finds thousands of tax account breaches, urges stronger protections

description: Conservative Leader Pierre Poilievre made the case for his continuing leadership to party faithful Thursday, saying he will keep fighting the Liberals even after party turbulence on his watch helped deliver Prime Minister Mark Carney a majority government.
title: Poilievre tells Conservatives he will stay on and 'keep fighting' after Carney secures majority

description: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio met Pope Leo at the Vatican on Thursday morning, in a visit that was officially about diplomacy but in reality was about cleaning up after President Donald Trump’s latest swipes at the first American pope.
title: In meeting with Pope Leo, Rubio tries to minimize Trump's attacks

description: More than 500 Albertans who accessed a public, searchable database that revealed the personal information of millions of voters have been issued cease-and-desist letters.
title: Elections Alberta says it has issued 568 cease-and-desist letters over Centurion Project leak

description: Prime Minister Mark Carney has said wages are rising faster than inflation. CBC’s Fact Check team dives deeper into that claim
title: Fact check: Are wages rising faster than inflation?

description: More than a decade after the intended lifespan of their pistols lapsed, Mounties across Canada are getting a new sidearm — but their union says the significant delay shows why the RCMP's procurement process needs to be overhauled.
title: Procurement delays putting Mounties at risk, says union

description: Three people with connections to a deadly hantavirus-stricken cruise are isolating at home in Ontario and Quebec, the federal government said Thursday as consular officials headed to the Canary Islands to meet four Canadians who remain on board.
title: 3 Canadians isolating in Ontario, Quebec after hantavirus ship outbreak

description: A teenager worried about his family's home and an 84-year-old concerned about agricultural impacts both saw the online comments they left on Alto's interactive map taken down. The Crown corporation says their feedback has been restored, but the initial removal has shaken their faith in the consultation process.
title: They shared their fears about high-speed rail. Then their comments disappeared

description: Louise Arbour will be installed as Canada's next governor general on June 8.
title: Louise Arbour to be installed Canada's next governor general June 8

description: Serve Robotics, a U.S.-based company, will run the pilot program in the downtown and Kitsilano neighbourhoods, starting this fall.
title: Vancouver approves 6-month delivery robot pilot program

description: The province of Manitoba has declared a public health emergency related to HIV as it continues to see some of the highest rates of the disease in Canada, the provincial chief public health officer announced Thursday.
title: Manitoba declares public health emergency as HIV rates rise
Stores across Sudbury, Ont., sell out of bottled water as advisory continues

description: Sunshine Village says an exceptionally snowy winter is allowing the resort to extend ski season into the summer. The resort plans to operate one lift and several ski runs from June 20 to July 5. This is the second time in nearly 35 years it has offered summer skiing.
title: Banff Sunshine plans summer ski season after snowy winter

description: Airliners carrying 13 Australian women and children with alleged ties to the Islamic State group landed in on Thursday in their homeland, where the adults face potential criminal charges relating to their alleged time in the extremist organization's so-called caliphate, which spanned Syria and Iraq.
title: Australian women, children linked to ISIS return from Syria
N.L. man set to take stand in trial for 1st-degree murder of his estranged wife

description: Johanna Sutcliffe's family is critical of the care she received in her final days, and they’re calling for systemic change to close what they see as a gap in provincial standards of care at special care homes.
title: In the days before she died, no one called for medical help. Her family wants change

description: Workers at a private company the Nova Scotia government contracts to care for deeply vulnerable people say Arden Professional Client Care is scrambling to replace some of its most experienced staff.
title: N.S. care workers say company scrambling to replace staff as long-standing workers leave

description: A major Mexican trade mission to Canada launched Thursday, involving over 200 Mexican businesses seeking to expand commercial links during the two-day, two-city encounter that will include high-level talks on the Canada-US-Mexico Agreement.
title: Mexico trade mission launches in Toronto as businesses seek to expand ties with Canada

description: Canada’s military is quietly deploying counter-drone defences at ports and air bases, racing to keep pace with lessons from Ukraine’s devastating strikes on Russian assets. The effort exposes a legal and operational grey zone — how to stop airborne threats over Canadian cities without disrupting civilian life or crossing regulatory lines.
title: The drone war comes home: Canada scrambles to shield military bases in legal grey zone

description: Changes to gambling laws in 2021 have given rise to apps that allow users to bet money on sporting events, along with built-in casinos offering games like blackjack, roulette or poker. One
title: The night started with a $25 online sports bet. It ended in a $14K loss

description: Some young Canadians are getting more intentional with their technology use and opting for digital minimalism — a paring down of all-encompassing devices like smartphones — of their own volition.
title: These students are limiting their own smartphone, social media and tech use. Here's why
